name: timo
description: Root task runner for the TIMO monorepo (backend + frontend).

scripts.lint: pnpm -C backend lint && pnpm -C frontend lint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm -C backend lint:fix && pnpm -C frontend lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C backend typecheck && pnpm -C frontend typecheck
scripts.format: pnpm -C backend format && pnpm -C frontend format
scripts.format:check: pnpm -C backend format:check && pnpm -C frontend format:check
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.install:all: pnpm -C backend install && pnpm -C frontend install
